# backstage-plugins-poc

A basic Backstage plugin

## Quickstart

To create your own Backstage plugin and publish it to Artifactory, follow these steps:

1. Click "Use this template"

2. Create the repository in your team's organization

3. Develop your plugin (See ["Plugin Development"](https://backstage.io/docs/plugins/plugin-development))

4. Run `yarn package` to build your plugin

5. Update the publish config in `package.json`:

```json
"publishConfig": {
  "registry": "https://gapinc.jfrog.io/artifactory/api/npm/npm-repos/"
}
```

6. Run `yarn publish` to publish your plugin to Artifactory
